## Type of change

- [ ] Editorial only (typos, formatting, links): light review is enough
- [ ] **Substantive** (adds or changes a claim, number, citation, definition, taxonomy element, or evidence tag): scientific review required

## Scientific-review checklist (author)

- [ ] Every new or changed claim cites a source, and every cited key exists in `references.bib`.
- [ ] Every new BibTeX entry has a row in `references-verification.md` saying how and when it was verified against the primary record.
- [ ] Peer-reviewed status was confirmed on the venue's own listing or publisher record, not inferred from an arXiv comment.
- [ ] Every claim carries an evidence tag: [PR], [PP], [VC], [EE], or [OP].
- [ ] Our own terms, frameworks, and hypotheses are marked [OP] and are not presented as findings.
- [ ] Numbers are quoted with their setup (benchmark, split, model; budget and date where relevant).
- [ ] Dates were checked; nothing is called "latest" or "state of the art" without a dated check.
- [ ] Quotations are brief and attributed.
- [ ] No empty headings; new sections contain substantive content.
- [ ] Limitations and counter-evidence are stated where relevant.
- [ ] AI assistance (if any) is disclosed below, and a human opened each cited primary source.

**AI assistance used:** <!-- none / describe -->

## Scientific-review checklist (reviewer)

- [ ] I re-opened each new primary source and confirmed the claims attributed to it.
- [ ] I agree with the evidence classes, or I have commented where I do not.
- [ ] I checked that conclusions do not go beyond the evidence cited.
